user.title: Choose GWM cloud region
user.description: Choose the region used by the official GWM app for this account.

data_description.region: This must match the account registration region, not the vehicle's current location.

account.title: Sign in to GWM
account.description: Enter the account details used by the official app. Authentication is performed directly against the selected GWM cloud. The generated device identity and account-bound authentication state are stored privately for restart recovery and excluded from diagnostics.

data_description.country: Two-letter country where the account is registered.
data_description.authentication_method: For Australia and New Zealand, use the current app login unless this account previously worked with the retired add-on.
data_description.account: Use the same account identifier as the official GWM app.
data_description.password: Stored in the Home Assistant config entry for account-bound restart recovery and reauthentication; it is redacted from diagnostics.

verification.title: Enter verification code
verification.description: Enter the one-time code sent by GWM. Codes are used once and are never stored.

session_reclaim.title: Allow ANZ session login
session_reclaim.description: Australia and New Zealand accounts permit only one active session. Continuing may sign out the official app. A dedicated shared-vehicle account is recommended.

data.allow_session_reclaim: I understand and want to continue

initialization.title: Retry China service initialization
initialization.description: GWM login succeeded, but {failure_count} downstream service stage(s) did not initialize. Retry with the saved recoverable G-App session without requesting another SMS code.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure GWM
reconfigure.description: Choose the replacement account region. You will authenticate before the current settings are changed.

reconfigure_account.title: Authenticate replacement account
reconfigure_account.description: The replacement settings are applied only after GWM accepts them. Changing account context securely discards all old account-bound authentication and command-journal state.

data_description.authentication_method: Changing this method discards the previous account-bound session and requires a fresh login.

reauth_confirm.title: Reconnect GWM
reauth_confirm.description: Confirm the account and complete any requested password or verification step.

error.invalid_account: Check the account, password, country, and selected region.
error.invalid_verification_code: The verification code was rejected or expired.
error.rate_limited: GWM rate-limited the request. Wait before trying again.
error.service_error: GWM rejected the request with an unsupported or unexpected response.
error.local_configuration_error: The bundled regional security material could not be validated.
error.unsupported_region: This cloud region is not available for setup yet.
error.initialization_failed: The downstream GWM services still could not initialize.
error.session_reclaim_not_confirmed: Confirm that you understand the ANZ single-session effect before continuing.

abort.already_configured: This GWM account is already configured.
abort.invalid_flow_state: This setup continuation is no longer valid. Start the flow again.
abort.legacy_addon_entry: The previous add-on based entry cannot be converted. Remove it and add GWM again to sign in directly.
abort.risk_control_required: GWM requires a risk-control challenge. Complete it in the official app before trying again.

init.title: GWM options
init.description: Choose the cloud polling interval and explicit feature opt-ins.

data_description.enable_remote_commands: Explicit opt-in for supported remote command controls.
data_description.enable_charging_control: Independent explicit opt-in for charging schedules.
data_description.security_pin: Required for remote commands outside mainland China. The stored value is shown in a masked password field and remains redacted from diagnostics.

error.security_pin_required: A vehicle security PIN is required when remote commands are enabled for this region.

abort.legacy_addon_entry: The previous add-on based entry cannot be configured. Remove it and add GWM again.

cloud_auth_failed.message: GWM rejected the stored cloud authentication. Reauthenticate the integration.

cloud_request_failed.message: The GWM cloud could not complete the request.

remote_command_unavailable.message: Remote commands are unavailable. Enable them in the integration options and configure a security PIN where required.

charging_control_unavailable.message: Charging control is unavailable. Enable it in the integration options.

invalid_climate_run_time.message: Climate run time must be a whole number from 5 to 30 minutes.

set_charging_plan.name: Set charging plan
set_charging_plan.description: Set the vehicle's charging schedule. The car charges only inside the window; a window that starts in the future pauses charging until then. Requires charging control in the integration options.

vin.name: VIN
vin.description: The vehicle VIN as shown on the device (the readable serial, e.g. LGWTEST00XX000001).

start_time.name: Start time
start_time.description: When charging may start. Set a future time to pause charging until then.

end_time.name: End time
end_time.description: When charging stops. The window must be at least 5 minutes.

clear_charging_plan.name: Clear charging plan
clear_charging_plan.description: Clear the vehicle's charging schedule so the car charges whenever it is plugged in.

vin.name: VIN
vin.description: The vehicle VIN, as shown on the device.
